movelist.name: Toxic
movelist.effect: The target is Badly Poisoned. If the user is Poison Type, Toxic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Giga Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Moonlight
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Lucky Chant
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Lucky Chant may activate it when receiving a Critical Hit to cause the attack to instead deal damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Lucky Chant may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Hay Fever
abilities.trigger: The user uses a Status Move; or the user ends
abilities.effect: The user creates a Burst 2 or Close Blast 3 of allergenic pollen. All Trainers and Pokémon in the burst that are not Bug, Grass, or Poison Typed lose a Tick of Hit Points. This Ability cannot be activated in Rainy Weather, Sandstorms, or if it is Hailing.

abilities.name: Dust Cloud
abilities.effect: Connection - Poison Powder. The user may use Moves with the Powder Keyword as if they had a Range of “Burst 1”.

abilities.name: Life Force
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Hit Points.
